product_family: Looker Studio is Google's free data visualization and reporting platform (formerly Google Data Studio), with a premium paid tier (Looker Studio Pro). It enables non-technical users to create interactive dashboards and reports by connecting to various data sources via built-in and partner connectors.

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: No explicit public evidence of Looker Studio holding SOC 2 Type 1 or Type 2 certification. The premium 'Looker' BI product has SOC 2 Type 1 (GCP) and Type 2 (AWS), but this is distinct from Looker Studio. Data Studio documentation states it 'supports' SOC 2 compliance standards, meaning customers can achieve SOC 2 compliance using it, but Google has not published its own SOC 2 audit report for Looker Studio.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Looker Studio supports HIPAA compliance within the scope of the Google Cloud Platform Business Associate Agreement (BAA). Customers must execute the BAA before using Looker Studio with PHI, and responsibility for ensuring HIPAA compliance rests with the customer. This is not a HIPAA certification held by Google, but rather support for customer HIPAA compliance.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: If you're subject to GDPR, you must complete all required fields within Data Studio > User Settings > Account & Privacy to comply with GDPR.

privacy.ai_training_note: Google does not use customer data to train its AI/LLM models without explicit permission. Data processed through Looker Studio is not used for training Google's foundation models. This policy is consistent across Google Cloud products.
privacy.data_region: Global (customer data stored in Google Cloud regions; EU data can be stored in EU regions per GDPR requirements)

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: HTTPS with TLS encryption for all data transmitted between client and server

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES-256 encryption for all data at rest in Looker Studio storage

security.name: Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
security.value: MFA supported and configurable via Google Workspace/Cloud Identity, with support for app-based authenticators (Google Authenticator, Authy)

security.name: Audit Logging
security.value: Comprehensive audit logs tracking user activity, logins, report generation, data access, and administrative actions; available via Admin console

security.name: Access Controls
security.value: Row-level security (RLS), granular sharing controls, file permission management, and integration with Google Workspace/Cloud Identity for centralized access control

security.name: Vulnerability Scanning
security.value: Front-end application and back-end infrastructure scanned for known security vulnerabilities at least monthly

security.name: Data Isolation
security.value: Customer logs stored within tenant project of customer's Google Cloud project, isolated from other customer log streams

products.name: Looker Studio (Free)
products.data_scope: User-owned reports; personal or shared workspace; covered by Google Privacy Policy for free accounts
products.notes: No-cost tier with unlimited reports and access to 500+ data connectors. Suitable for individual analysts and small teams.

products.name: Looker Studio Pro
products.data_scope: Team workspaces and organization-owned reports; covered by Google Cloud Privacy Policy; supports admin controls and governance
products.notes: Paid tier (~$5 to 10 per user per month) adding team collaboration, automated report delivery, Google support, and advanced admin controls. Includes sandbox environment and granular permissions.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium: Looker Studio (free) + Looker Studio Pro (paid SaaS, per-user/month)
compare.data_residency: Global, with EU data residency option for GDPR compliance; customer data stored in Google Cloud regions

flags: Looker Studio (free/Pro visualization tool) and Looker (premium BI platform) are separate products with different compliance scopes; Looker BI has SOC 2 Type 1/2, but Looker Studio does not.

Looker Studio documentation does not publicly claim SOC 2 Type 1 or Type 2 certification. Upstream Google Cloud services may have SOC 2, but the Looker Studio product specifically does not advertise this.

Looker Studio supports HIPAA compliance via BAA, but this is not HIPAA certification of the product. Customers remain responsible for configuration and compliance; Google provides the tools and agreement.
Full compliance documentation for Looker products is available upon request for customers/prospects under NDA, so a complete public cert list may not exist.
